title: Move concrete dependencies into creators
purpose: Compare direct concrete coupling with abstraction dependency via factory method.
alt: 구체 피자에 직접 의존하는 DependentPizzaStore와 추상 Pizza에 의존하는 Factory Method 구조 비교
requiredChecks: Before: DependentPizzaStore directly creates concrete regional pizza classes.
After: abstract PizzaStore uses abstract Pizza instead of directly creating concrete products.
Regional creator subclasses perform concrete instantiation; creation dependencies still exist in subclasses.
Concrete NYStyleCheesePizza, NYStyleClamPizza, ChicagoStyleCheesePizza extend Pizza in the after panel.
prompt: Create a NEW ORIGINAL English raster technical diagram for a design-pattern reference blog.
